## Measurements (D1 definition / statistics / timing only)

**X01.** Decision-cut snapshots by backward availability. ETF/futures minute contact only after bar close (`known_at = t_close + 1 minute`, same `SOURCE_LAG_NS` as physical vol). Per-source age, missing mask, calendar overlap (US cash vs CME 18:00–17:00 NY wallclock). No future-nearest match. Daily cash `known_at` = next cash open after that date; **cash-index daily values cannot certify intraday touches**.

**X02 (descriptive, not fitted).** Same-cut NQ/QQQ and ES/SPY ratios and residuals in native units (`price_points` vs ETF USD). Roll-adjusted futures changes via YM/NQ/ES maps. Jacobian tagged; `mini_equivalents` is informational only. Option parity `F=K+(C−P)/D` waits for options D1. Affine/Kalman mapping is Context.

**X07.PRICE_SMT.** Own-reference breach order, relative excursion, standardized close-to-close log returns (`Unit.LOG_RETURN`) on aligned 1/5/15/60-minute completed bars. Normalize by prior session scales. Confirmed-pivot vs running-reference kept separate (`compare_reference_breaches`). No `fit_divergence_residual`.

**X05.** Source bar-close events (QQQ/SPY/YM/RTY reference breach or completed-bar extreme) → receiver 1/5/15/30-minute log-return/excursion **tables**, including no receiver local node, already-reacted, failed transmission, and holiday/stale source. Entry after source close + lag. Common-market residual is a **descriptive** contemporaneous ES/NQ move, not a fitted beta.

**C20 (axes only).** Prefix session log-return, physical-vol percentile from accepted tables, event proximity from scheduled-event links, coverage/missingness. No HMM/smoother.

**C17 in this family:** time-to/from known scheduled labels only. Surprise/revision stays unavailable (DA-11; FRED `realtime_start=realtime_end=2026-09-04` on `usd-rates.parquet`, 30,032 rows).

Report denominators, independent dates, overlap vs full-support cohorts, no-event/censored, source-age bins, roll-jump exclusions. Chronological cuts: train 2020–2022, development 2023–2024, confirmation 2025-01-01–2026-09-03 — **statistics only**, no fits.

## Pilot and runtime (source-grounded)

**Pilot:** NQ2020 primary (346,579 rows) + YM `ohlcv-1m/2020.parquet` + QQQ `ohlcv-1m/2020.parquet` + four daily cash symbols on 2020 cash dates + YM roll segments overlapping 2020. No trades, no DBN, no COT.
